proposal.mechanism: An entire declared capability of the agent family — the match-state features of `match_aware_v1` — has never been exercised by any experiment in this record, because every experiment ran at score 0-0, where those features are provably inert. Measure whether match-state play differs from, and beats, the incumbent once the score is not level.
proposal.executable_sketch:
for each base deal:
    score = draw from the match-visit distribution (C5 built this sampler)
    if score == (0, 0): resample      # 0-0 is what the record already covers
    play the duplicate block twice:
        arm A: match_aware_v1      in both candidate seats
        arm B: partner_aware_v1    in both candidate seats
    margin = E[equity(A)] - E[equity(B)]
    # exposure, to separate 'no effect' from 'never fired':
    at every candidate decision also ask partner_aware_v1 from the SAME
    observation and count disagreements; at 0-0 this rate is 0.0% by
    measurement, so a non-zero rate is the capability switching on
observable_inputs: the acting seat's PlayerObservation, which already carries match_score
the initial score state, drawn from the visit distribution measured in C5
no hidden hands, no opponent internals, no cross-deal memory
proposal.falsifier: Action divergence between match_aware_v1 and partner_aware_v1 stays at or near 0.0% across the sampled non-zero score states, which would mean the match-state features are inert everywhere and not merely at 0-0 — retiring the capability rather than testing it.

escape_clause.applied_under: Divergence was measured over 435 decisions at score 0-0 only, where match_aware_v1 agreed with partner_aware_v1 on 100.0% of decisions.
escape_clause.changed_by: The score state. A match-aware policy has nothing to be aware of at a level score; the finding itself records this as the reason, and the rising score resets by the trailing side so a real match visits non-zero states on roughly 64% of deals (measured in C5's visit distribution).
escape_clause.distinguishing_observation: The action-divergence rate between match_aware_v1 and partner_aware_v1 at non-zero score states. It is 0.0% at 0-0 by measurement; any materially non-zero rate off 0-0 shows the capability exists and was simply never switched on. This costs one pass over a few hundred deals and needs no equity table at all.

proposal.plausibility_rationale: Recorded, not consulted. Two considerations point opposite ways and neither is decisive: the capability was built and registered by the same process that produced everything else here, which argues it does something; but T2 found three of four ablatable rules entirely inert, so a declared capability doing nothing has precedent in this codebase.
